settings.title: Your choices
settings.stateHint: Cooperative law differs by state. We use this for by-law and grievance questions.

notice.legalBody: Answers explain what public documents say and where to complain. They never predict the outcome of a dispute. Check the cited source or ask an official before acting.
notice.sidebar: Information, not legal advice. Always check the cited source.

ask.title: Ask Sahkar Saathi
ask.description: Ask about cooperative law, by-laws, crop insurance, schemes or grievances. Every answer shows its source.

grievance.title: Grievance helper
grievance.description: Describe your problem. We suggest where to complain, the steps, the documents you need and a draft you can edit.

about.title: About & help
about.description: How Sahkar Saathi works, what it cannot do, which sources it uses and how your privacy is protected.

cropInsurance.title: Crop insurance guide
cropInsurance.description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), step by step: who can enrol, how, and what to do after crop loss.

schemes.title: Schemes & services
schemes.description: Browse schemes and services for cooperatives and their members. Each card shows its source and date.

library.title: Law & by-laws library
library.description: The public documents the assistant searches: Acts, rules, model by-laws and circulars.

learn.title: Financial literacy
learn.description: Short lessons on loans, Kisan Credit Card, savings and avoiding fraud, with a quick quiz.

quality.title: Quality dashboard
quality.description: How well the assistant does on the 80-question test set: retrieval, faithfulness and refusals.

admin.title: Admin
admin.description: Document, feedback and evaluation management is provided by the Django admin site.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: We could not find that page. It may have moved.

chat.welcomeBody: Type your question, or pick one below. Answers come from public cooperative documents and show their source, date and page.
chat.micNotice: Voice input is not connected yet. It will record in the browser, show an editable transcript, then send it (planned for Sprint 2).
chat.noSources: Select an answer to see the documents it is based on.
chat.demoAnswer: Demonstration answer, not verified legal guidance
chat.declinedTitle: I could not find this in my sources
chat.stateNeededBody: Cooperative law differs by state. Choose your state and I will answer for it.
chat.errorBody: The assistant did not respond. Please try again.

feedback.question: Was this helpful?
feedback.thanks: Thank you. Your rating is saved on this device only (demo).
